evals.prompt: FSD 项目里登录后的 token 现在存在 features/auth 里，但几乎每个页面的请求都要带上它，很多地方在跨 feature import，很乱。token 应该放哪？给出迁移思路。
evals.expected_output: App-wide token doesn't belong to one feature → shared/api (or shared/auth) with a shared api client (interceptor/initializer); explains the layer import rule and public API via index.ts.
expectations: Recommends moving the token down to shared (shared/api or shared/auth) instead of keeping it in features/auth
Explains the FSD layer import rule (a layer may only import from layers strictly below)
Mentions public API via index.ts for cross-module imports
Addresses how the shared api client receives the token (interceptor / initializer) rather than feature-to-feature imports

evals.prompt: 新需求做一个商品详情页：页面里有一块“商品卡片”（图片+价格+加购按钮），产品说购物车抽屉里也要用一模一样的这块卡片。这块 UI 该放在哪层？pages、widgets、features、entities、shared 怎么选？
evals.expected_output: The reusable product card is a business-entity view → entities/product (entity UI); add-to-cart is a feature (feature/add-to-cart) invoked via props/callbacks; the page composes them. Reasoning via the layer decision flow.
expectations: Places the reusable product card at the entities level (entity UI) rather than pages/widgets
Treats add-to-cart as a feature (feature/add-to-cart) wired in via props/callbacks
Explains the decision using the layer decision flow (whose business meaning it carries / how many contexts reuse it)

evals.prompt: Review 这个 import：entities/user/model/user-store.ts 里写了 import { headerModel } from 'features/header'。有没有问题？怎么改？
evals.expected_output: Violation: entities cannot import from a higher layer (features). Fix by inverting the dependency (pass data via props/callbacks) or moving the shared piece down a layer — not by re-pathing the import.
expectations: Identifies the import as a layer violation (entities must not import from features)
Proposes a concrete fix: invert the dependency (store receives data via props/callbacks) or move the shared logic down a layer
Does not suggest merely changing the import path to bypass the rule
